summary.text: Cecil Abels is the Democratic nominee for the New Hampshire State Senate, District 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Republican incumbent James Gray.
Ballotpedia reports that Abels unofficially withdrew from the race but will continue to appear on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Cecil Abels said he was born in Okinawa to two Navy veteran parents and raised in the New Hampshire seacoast area, where he graduated from Coe-Brown Northwood Academy.
He earned a bachelor's degree in English teaching from the University of New Hampshire in 2006, according to Ballotpedia and his survey.
He said he opened a barbecue restaurant in Rochester in 2021, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as restaurateur.
Abels advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.
In the survey he named property taxes and affordability among his priorities, and said decisions affecting local tax bills should be made locally.
